description: Daily affirmations for confidence, calm, and motivation — pick a focus and get 10 positive statements to copy or repeat.

faqs.a: Confidence (self-belief), calm (peace and balance), and motivation (drive and energy) — 15 affirmations each.
Each click generates 10 unique affirmations from your chosen category.
faqs.q: How many do I get per click?

faqs.a: Click any affirmation or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy an affirmation?

howto: Click any affirmation to copy it.
